item.text:
The recorded design has three control samples (S1–S3) and three treated samples (S4–S6), with replicate numbers 1–3 in each condition. The design meets the stage 01 minimum of two distinct samples per group.

The metadata does not say whether these are independent biological replicates, paired samples, or samples processed in different batches. The replicate numbers alone do not establish pairing. Those details can affect how a differential test should be set up and interpreted, but they can’t be determined from this design file.

Stage 01 has written the samplesheet and design table. Stage 02 is still waiting for you to say you’re ready.
